facts.raw_span: A 20-year-old woman was being monitored for a left ciliary body mass for 3 years presented with declining vision in her left eye
Her best-corrected visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/50 OS
Pupils, intraocular pressures, anterior chambers, and lenses were unremarkable in both eyes
a nasal mass posterior to the lens was evident, which had grown considerably in size since her last visit
Ophthalmoscopic examination showed a large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
Ultra-widefield imaging: White mass emanating anteriorly from the nasal ciliary body and protruding into the vitreous cavity
Vitreous aspirate cytology: Negative for malignant cells
Hypovascular myxoid lesion composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells with spindle nuclei
S100 (neural crest marker): Positive
Glial fibrillary acidic protein (astrocyte marker): Patchy positive
CD34 (fibroblast marker): Negative
Smooth muscle actin: Negative
A 20-year-old woman was being monitored for a left ciliary body mass for 3 years presented with declining vision in her left eye
Her best-corrected visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/50 OS
Pupils, intraocular pressures, anterior chambers, and lenses were unremarkable in both eyes
a nasal mass posterior to the lens was evident, which had grown considerably in size since her last visit
Ophthalmoscopic examination showed a large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity
Ultra-widefield imaging: White mass emanating anteriorly from the nasal ciliary body and protruding into the vitreous cavity
Vitreous aspirate cytology: Negative for malignant cells
Hypovascular myxoid lesion composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells with spindle nuclei
S100 (neural crest marker): Positive
Glial fibrillary acidic protein (astrocyte marker): Patchy positive
CD34 (fibroblast marker): Negative
Smooth muscle actin: Negative

concepts.why: The presence of a large white mass protruding into the vitreous cavity, composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells with spindle nuclei, and positive for S100, is consistent with medulloepithelioma.
The growth of the nasal mass and its protrusion into the vitreous cavity, despite negative cytology for malignant cells, could suggest a ciliary body melanoma.
The hypovascular myxoid lesion with positive S100 staining and patchy positive glial fibrillary acidic protein could be consistent with a neurofibroma, a congenital anomaly.
The hypovascular myxoid lesion with negative smooth muscle actin and CD34 staining could suggest a myxoma, a degenerative disease.
The presence of a nasal mass posterior to the lens could be consistent with a coloboma, a congenital anomaly.
The large white mass emanating anteriorly from the nasal ciliary body could suggest a choroidal osteoma, an ocular tumor.
The growth of the nasal mass and its protrusion into the vitreous cavity could be consistent with a scleral ectasia, a traumatic injury.
The presence of a large white mass and negative cytology for malignant cells could suggest a uveal effusion syndrome, an inflammatory condition.

rationales.F07: Negative vitreous aspirate cytology suggests a non-malignant process.
rationales.F08: Hypovascular myxoid lesion is consistent with myxoma.
rationales.F09: Positive S100 staining suggests a neural crest origin, which is consistent with neurofibroma.
